required_manual_checks.description: Record the owner's answers before building: Q2a — redirect /partner to /sales and drop its nav entry (owner statement in this session: 'redirect /partner to /sales and remove that redundant nav entry'); Q2b — the default landing does NOT change ('leaving Galaxy as the default landing'). If Q2b were yes, the landing change would be a separate decision, not part of this task.

app/partner/page.tsx becomes a permanent redirect to /sales, following the retired /search precedent (app/search/page.tsx): no reader reached, so its PAGE_AUTHORIZATION entry becomes [] exactly as 'search' is, with the reason recorded where the entry was. Any query string that has a /sales meaning (scope) is forwarded; nothing else is. Unauthenticated requests are still sent to /login by the existing proxy before the redirect matters.

Remove the Partner destination from NAV_DESTINATIONS and its NavRail icon mapping. LANDING_ORDER is currently ['/', '/partner']: replace the fallback with '/sales' (the page /partner now forwards to), and prove with the landing tests that the owner and the sales principal still land on '/' (Galaxy primacy, owner-recorded) and that no principal lands on a denial or on a redirect. No destination gains a principal: nav-visibility and page-denial keep their meaning for every remaining destination, and the Sales destination's own demand is unchanged.

On /sales, a stage summary for the same scope as the queue (Mine + unassigned or Team): the count of open prospects per stage (lead, contacted, proposal), each linking to /sales/list with that stage and scope. One bounded aggregate through the existing read path and the existing authorized lease (no second authorization), computed in SQL over active, anchored prospects; no writes, no schema or index change. db tests assert the counts equal the filtered list's totals per stage, as owner and as partner, and that the partner's Mine counts exclude another member's prospects.

Slice 1C rendered proof with the fixture-PG17 method (never production), owner AND partner, 390x844, 640x900, 667x375, 768x1024, 1024x800, 1440x900: /partner answers with a redirect to /sales; the NavRail (desktop and mobile) no longer offers Partner; the stage summary renders without overflow, targets at least 44 px on coarse pointers, visible keyboard focus. Screenshots inspected, kept out of the repository.

scripts/deploy-smoke.mjs A6 expects /partner to load (200); after this slice it answers with a redirect. The smoke is rollout tooling and is NOT changed here; the checkpoint records that the next rollout's preparation must update A6 (and add Priority and stage-summary checks for 2A.3b/2A.3c).

Diff limited to the write paths; every test file that references /partner or LANDING_ORDER was enumerated before drafting and is listed. The builder runs the full db phase locally before freezing, not only the files it edited. No production contact by the builder.

title: 2A.3c One pipeline: /partner permanently redirects to /sales, the Partner nav destination is removed, and /sales shows a stage summary (no landing change)
